newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia sees inflation around 7.0 pct this year.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia sees inflation around 7.0 pct this year.

text.p: Indonesia's Planning Minister Ginanjar Kartasasmita on Monday predicted annual inflation at around seven percent in calendar 1996.
"I am optimistic we can control our inflation. I think inflation will be around seven percent this year," Ginanjar told reporters.
"We know why the inflation was quite high in past years. We will continue to monitor supply and demand of goods, so we can reduce inflation," he said.
Indonesia's year-on-year inflation as measured by the consumer price index in August was 7.21 percent, compared with 7.26 percent in July.
Inflation in 1995 was 8.6 percent and cumulative inflation in the first seven months of the year is 4.98 percent.
